0022600169.text: The Trail Blazers (4-1, 1st in the Northwest) are on a one-game winning streak and have gone 3-0 on the road, while the Nuggets (3-2, 3rd in the Northwest) are on a two-game winning streak. Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Portland lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 137-132 defeat in Denver on April 6, 2026.
